title: clitoria falcata var. aurantiaca
intro: Clitoria falcata var. aurantiaca, commonly known as Butterfly Pea or Purple Pea, is a plant species from the Fabaceae family, known for its vibrant blue flowers and potential medicinal properties. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Clitoria falcata var. aurantiaca include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
